# WhiteSur Kvantum (dark and light)

`WhiteSurDark.svg`, `WhiteSurDark.kvconfig`, `WhiteSur.svg` and
`WhiteSur.kvconfig` (the light theme, for RedRog's light variant) from
[WhiteSur-kde](https://github.com/vinceliuice/WhiteSur-kde) by Vince Liuice,
commit `cf4df59`, unmodified. License: GPL-3.0 (see `LICENSE`).

RedRog's Qt application style (`modules/kvantum`) is built from these files:
macOS-like rounded controls and translucent, blurred menus, recolored to the
RedRog palette by `lib/recolor.py`.
